Plot eye movements for one trial (or trial type)

Source: R/gorilla_eye_plot.R
gorilla_eye_plot.Rd

Takes eye tracking data that has been processed by gorilla_eye_processing() and makes a heat map and/or a path plot of where people looked. You can add a background image and mark the zones of interest. Gaze position is plotted in normalised screen coordinates, from 0 to 1 in both directions.

Usage

gorilla_eye_plot(
  data,
  background = NULL,
  zones = NULL,
  plot_types = c("heat", "path"),
  outp = "analysis",
  title = "plot",
  contrast = NULL
)

Arguments

data

The list returned by gorilla_eye_processing(); the gaze samples are taken from its ed item (columns t, x and y). You will usually want to filter this to a single trial or condition first.

background

Optional file name of a .png image to draw behind the gaze data, eg a screenshot of the stimulus.

zones

Optional data.table describing zones to draw as boxes, with columns zone_name, left, right, bottom and top. A zone called "screen" is ignored.

plot_types

Which plots to make: "heat" for a heat map, "path" for the gaze path. Default is both.

outp

Name of a folder to save the plots in, as pdfs (it is created if needed). Set to NULL or "" to not save.

title

Start of the file name for the saved plots; the plot type is added to the end.

contrast

Optional name of a column in data$ed used to colour the gaze path, eg to compare two conditions.

Value

A named list of ggplot objects, one for each of plot_types.

See also

gorilla_eye_processing()
